title: Gamepad support: add controller bindings to all input actions (DD-007)
description: Add full gamepad/controller support to the demo while keeping keyboard/mouse working (additive), per docs/DECISIONES-DISENO.md DD-007. Add JoypadButton / JoypadMotion events to every existing InputMap action in project.godot so the game is fully playable on an Xbox-style controller. Mapping (DD-007): left stick + D-pad for move_left/move_right and move_up/move_down (analog, deadzone ~0.3); jump=A(btn 0); dash=B(btn 1); glide=LT hold (left trigger, axis 4 value 1.0); fly=Y(btn 3); cast=RT (right trigger, axis 5 value 1.0); element_1/2/3 = D-pad left/up/right (buttons 13/11/14 — verify Godot 4 JOY_BUTTON_DPAD constants); element_cycle stays Q on keyboard, and add RB(btn 5)=cycle-next; optionally add an element_cycle_prev action on LB(btn 4). Keep all existing keyboard/mouse events. Note: D-pad up/down are used for element select while the LEFT STICK handles flight vertical, to avoid conflict — confirm move_up/move_down keep stick (axis 1) bindings and that D-pad up is element_2, not movement. Use Godot 4 joypad axis/button indices correctly (JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X=0, LEFT_Y=1, TRIGGER_LEFT=4, TRIGGER_RIGHT=5; JOY_BUTTON_A=0, B=1, Y=3, LEFT_SHOULDER=4, RIGHT_SHOULDER=5, DPAD_UP=11, DPAD_LEFT=13, DPAD_RIGHT=14). Update the debug HUD control hints to mention the gamepad. Movement and combat behavior/logic must not change — this is an input-binding layer only; verify no regression. Engine binary + GUT command in .claude/agents/project-context.md.
acceptance_criteria: Every gameplay InputMap action (move_left, move_right, move_up, move_down, jump, dash, glide, fly, cast, element_1, element_2, element_3, element_cycle) has at least one gamepad event (JoypadButton or JoypadMotion) in project.godot, matching the DD-007 layout, with all existing keyboard/mouse events preserved.

Left-stick movement is analog with a sensible deadzone (~0.3); glide and cast are bound to the left/right triggers as hold/press; jump/dash/fly on A/B/Y; element select on D-pad and element cycle on RB.
The project loads headless with zero script/scene parse errors, and the full GUT suite still passes (62 existing + any new) exit 0 — no movement/combat regression.

A GUT test asserts, via InputMap.action_get_events, that each gameplay action has at least one InputEventJoypadButton or InputEventJoypadMotion (gamepad coverage), so missing controller bindings are caught automatically.
The debug HUD control hints mention the gamepad controls (not only keyboard).

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Gamepad bindings added per DD-007 (commits e7f48a0 feat + a30004a test). The interrupted gamepad-dev agent had hung on a `cd ... && godot` permission prompt (root cause: cd in a compound Bash command, not OneDrive); fixed the run pattern to absolute --path with no cd. Agent had correctly authored most bindings (using the real Godot 4 JoyButton indices: A=0,B=1,Y=3,RB=10,DPAD up/left/right=11/13/14, triggers axis 4/5) but missed jump; orchestrator added the A(0) binding to jump. Verified independently: full GUT 64/64 pass exit 0, clean headless scene load. test_gamepad_bindings asserts joypad coverage for all 13 actions + keyboard parity (additive) — load-bearing (failed on jump before the fix). HUD shows gamepad controls. Done.
